Other candidates—text-service, home-timeline-service—are ambiguous or victims. No trace paths contradict this; the downstream explanation tests show no direct propagation links, but trace coverage is incomplete. Following the strict IVD rule, media-service must be selected as root cause over all ambiguous/victim candidates.

Compose-post-service then failed to write home timelines, causing further cascading. Nginx-web-server saw immediate CPU/memory spikes as requests began failing. Media-service later experienced a massive CPU spike at 10:26:00, likely due to abnormal request patterns from failed upstream calls. The IVD initiator label on media-service is temporally impossible as root cause; the true initiator is social-graph-service.

All other candidates are ranked lower: compose-post (victim, -6), home-timeline (victim, -6), social-graph (ambiguous, 1), nginx (ambiguous, 4). No observed trace paths from media-service to downstream are noted, but IVD and timing support its primacy. Sub-second ordering remains unconfirmed, but the IVD tournament already accounts for temporal fragility. The cascade is best explained by media-service overload causing backpressure on compose-post, which then failed home-timeline writes and induced social-graph errors.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

results.rationale: social-graph-service owns the earliest and strongest source signal: an internal 'ZADD: no key specified' exception at 1650166646.037s that names no dependency. Immediate CPU (1649s) and memory (1647s) anomalies confirm local mechanism. IVD tournament ranks it as the sole initiator (Copeland 2); all other source candidates are victims or ambiguous. NoiseLab downstream explanation confirms social-graph's anomaly can account for the resource spikes and error logs of compose-post, home-timeline, and later services. Compose-post and home-timeline only report dependency failures without own internal exceptions, fitting the IVD victim label. No trace spans contradict the inferred call chain. Temporal ordering is consistent, and onset gap is resolved by IVD initiator selection. Hard causal checks are satisfied: no dependency is blamed, internal mechanism precedes all caller symptoms, and no later candidate has superior source evidence.
uncertainties: No trace spans to confirm whether a malformed request from home-timeline-service could have triggered the exception, but onset timing and IVD verdict strongly favor internal origin.

Underlying Redis/ storage state is unobserved; if Redis key space corruption existed, social-graph might have been a victim, but the exception type (no key specified) suggests application logic defect.

Home-timeline-service and compose-post-service, its callers, failed immediately afterward, explicitly logging social-graph-service as the cause. IVD ranks social-graph-service top but labels all candidates ambiguous due to missing caller/downstream evidence. Other services displayed later or stronger reactions, consistent with cascading load.
